quests.name: Hearthmere: Clear the Roads
quests.about: Kusa prowl the roads around Hearthmere. Thin them out.

steps.hint: They camp in the wilds of Hearthmere.

quests.offer: The Kusa are getting bold. Six of them, and the roads are safe again.
quests.done: The carts are moving again. Thank you.

quests.name: Hearthmere: Supply Run
quests.about: Gather at Marwick Woodlot for the town stores.
quests.offer: We are short on supplies. Marwick Woodlot has what we need.
quests.done: That will see us through the season.

quests.name: I · The Sundered Crown
quests.about: Elder Dorian tells of the Crown that once held Veilreach together, and of the five Wardens who keep its shards.
quests.offer: When the Veil tore, the Crown broke into shards and the land broke with it. Speak to our captain, then see the old stones for yourself.
quests.progress: The stones remember. Go and look.
quests.done: You felt it, didn't you? The land wants to be whole. The Wardens across the sea hold the shards.

quests.name: II · The Saltmire Shard
quests.about: Sail to Saltmire and earn the shard held by Elder Kit in Saltmire.

steps.hint: Saltmire, capital of Saltmire. Take a ferry from a harbour.

quests.offer: The nearest shard is in Saltmire. Find Elder Kit in Saltmire. The harbour can take you.
quests.progress: Elder Kit will not part with the shard cheaply.
quests.done: You have earned it. Take the Saltmire shard, and carry word to the next Warden.

intro:
Veilreach.

Once one kingdom under one Crown. When the Veil tore, the Crown shattered and the land split into seven: green Hearthmere, the marshes of Saltmire, the white Frostmarch, the burning Emberwaste, crystal Hollowdeep, the tombs of Bonereach, and the isle where the throne still stands.

You wake in Hearthmere. Find the Elder by the fountain. Roads join the towns; ferries cross the sea from every harbour.
